source_policy: Every node and edge is traced from the official Garden Route Mall mall map (Webflow lightbox on https://www.gardenroutemall.co.za/garden-route-mall-shops), original image supplied by the mission owner 2026-09-03. The enhanced/AI-redrawn copy was used ONLY to read labels, never for geometry. Positions were measured on the original as rendered in the session (417×888; native file size unverified; precision about ±5 px ≈ ±1.2 % x / ±0.6 % y) and expressed as scale-invariant percentages on the 1000:620 MallMind plane (source padded 121.73 % of its width on each side). The map has NO scale bar, so distance_unit is "px": no metres and no walking time are claimed anywhere, and a Sunday measurement of one leg must not be used to calibrate the whole map. Store destinations are corridor ARRIVAL points, not doors. Not an official Garden Route Mall deployment. Map artwork is NOT bundled (rights not confirmed).
coordinate_system: percent-based MallMind node coordinates (0..100) on the prepared 1000:620 plane derived from the official mall map; *_source fields are the canonical measurements on the unpadded original

source_image.description: original mall map image uploaded by the mission owner (lightbox asset from the official shops page)

notes: The map is a single sheet with no level labels; the pilot is modelled as one level ('L1', as drawn). Entrances visible on the sheet: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 (all on the east side, facing parking). Entrances 1 and 2 are not visible, so the 'Centre Management near Entrance 2' landmark cannot be used. Only Entrance 4 is a start; instructions are written for the Entrance 4 → south direction only.
